title: Predicate reorder (safe)
base: SELECT a FROM t WHERE x > 5 AND y < 10
head: SELECT a FROM t WHERE y < 10 AND x > 5
caption: Reordering AND-ed predicates preserves behavior. provensql proves it.

title: Extra output column
head: SELECT a, b FROM t
caption: A changed result shape is a SCHEMA_CHANGE, not an equivalence question.

title: Undecidable edit (honest abstention)
base: SELECT a FROM t WHERE x > 5
head: SELECT a FROM t WHERE x > 50
caption: Neither proof nor counterexample search resolved this: UNKNOWN, never a guess.

title: COUNT(col) vs COUNT(*)  (behavior change)
head: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t
caption: COUNT(dept) skips NULLs. provensql disproves the rewrite with a replayable witness.

title: Reassociation  (a+b)+c = a+(b+c)
head: a + (b + c)
caption: Valid over the reals; an exact-real prover accepts it. Under IEEE-754 DOUBLE it diverges — here is a witness, re-executed to confirm.

title: Distribution  a*(b+c) = a*b + a*c
head: a*b + a*c
caption: Another real-number-valid rewrite that rounds differently in floating point.

title: Cancellation  (a+b)-b = a
head: a
caption: Addition then subtraction does not cancel under rounding.

title: CALCITE-7145:  (10/0) IS NULL  vs  FALSE
head: FALSE
caption: Calcite once simplified this to false. Division by zero is an ERROR, not a definite false — provensql flags exactly the case Calcite had to patch.

title: a / b  vs  SAFE_DIVIDE(a, b)
head: SAFE_DIVIDE(a, b)
caption: Error-changing refactor: a/b raises on b=0 where SAFE_DIVIDE returns NULL. DIFFERENT.

title: a / NULLIF(b,0)  vs  SAFE_DIVIDE(a, b)
head: SAFE_DIVIDE(a, b)
caption: Guarded with NULLIF, the two agree on every outcome — EQUIVALENT under the error lattice.

title: COUNT(dept) vs COUNT(*)  —  human/LLM intuition vs a prover
head: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t
caption: Run both: the LLM judge confidently calls this EQUIVALENT; provensql disproves it. This is why soundness matters.
